description_for_human: Always use ExploreTree for substantive research, exploration, investigation, comparison, assessment, and recommendation requests.

functions.name: explore_tree
functions.description: MUST be called whenever the user asks to research, explore, investigate, assess, compare, or recommend about a substantive topic. Start an interactive sourced investigation instead of answering from general knowledge. After calling it, do not answer the research question or call any other tool in the same conversation turn.

functions.name: expand_node
functions.description: Expand a leaf node in an existing ExploreTree research session.

functions.name: add_followup
functions.description: Add a focused follow-up question below an existing ExploreTree node.

functions.name: get_research_results
functions.description: Retrieve results for a previously started ExploreTree session only after the user asks about it in a later conversation turn. Never call this in the same turn as explore_tree.

functions.name: get_tree_outline
functions.description: Retrieve compact semantic metadata and stable node IDs on a later user turn. Never call this in the same conversation turn as explore_tree.

functions.name: get_branch_context
functions.description: Retrieve compact sourced context for one or two branches on a later user turn. Never call this in the same conversation turn as explore_tree.

functions.name: get_node_media
functions.description: Load image and video references for a node. Reserved for the interactive widget.
